questions.text: Round half up, or to even like the ledger?
Show the rounding on the receipt?

sections.heading: Background
sections.text: Refunds are rounded per line, invoices on the total, so a refund can differ from its invoice by a cent.

sections.heading: Goal
sections.text:
A refund of a whole invoice returns exactly what the invoice charged.
Partial refunds keep rounding per line.

sections.heading: What we know
sections.text:
- Invoices round the total since 2.12.
- `Refund#amount` sums rounded lines.

sections.heading: Source
sections.text: Support thread about a refund one cent short.
